provenance.source: Business workbook template supplied by the report owner on 2026-11-19: a report-generator 0.2.0 business report edited by hand and saved by Microsoft Excel.
provenance.anonymized: The 37 class names are replaced by class_01 .. class_37 in sorted order, so row order is preserved. Every number is unchanged. Document properties, fonts, alignments, column widths and freeze panes are not stored.
provenance.cells: Each cell is [coordinate, value, number format, fill colour or null, formula]. A cell that held a formula in the template stores the value Excel cached for it and true in the last position. Cells with neither value nor fill are omitted.
provenance.inputs: The two input tables are rebuilt from the template model sheets under the source column names; perebrak and nedobrak are the percentage columns divided by 100. The goal columns are not inputs.
